notes.subject: ישכיב
notes.rationale: 'ka u sigi' (cause to lie down / stop) is KJV's reading; ASV/JPS read 'pour out' the water-jars — causative of שכב favors 'lay down'.

notes.subject: שחקים
notes.rationale: word means beaten-thin powder / thin cloud; rendered 'sankolo jiw' (waters of the sky), losing the dust-vapor picture.

notes.subject: jate
notes.rationale: the verse is a numbering question — who can count the clouds.

notes.subject: Iyubu
notes.rationale: Yawe's rhetorical questions in the whirlwind address Job directly.

translation: Jɔgɔ bɛ se ka sankolo jiw jate ni hakinɛ ye? Ani sankolo ka ji-nibɛnw, jɔgɔ bɛ se ka u sigi?
